andhraPradesh.headline: Bay of Bengal low-pressure system intensifies into depression; heavy-rain warning continues for Andhra Pradesh
facts: On 22 September, IMD reported that the Bay of Bengal system had intensified into a depression over the west-central and adjoining north-west Bay of Bengal.
IMD said the depression was likely to intensify further and move towards the north Andhra Pradesh–south Odisha coast; this was a forecast, not a completed landfall.
IMD forecast heavy to very heavy rainfall over parts of coastal Andhra Pradesh, with squally winds and rough sea conditions expected.
APSDMA and district authorities advised coastal residents to heed alerts and warned fishers against venturing into the sea.
andhraPradesh.summary: Previous: On 21 September, the weather system was reported as a low-pressure area with warnings of heavy rain and coastal hazards. Today: IMD reported that it had strengthened into a depression and continued warnings for coastal Andhra Pradesh. The system’s further intensification and movement towards the coast remained forecast at the time of reporting.
andhraPradesh.staticLink: Bay of Bengal cyclones and depressions; IMD early-warning systems; disaster preparedness and coastal risk reduction.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: Distinguish a depression from a low-pressure area and separate observed system status from forecast movement or rainfall.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: Assess how timely meteorological warnings, district coordination and fisher advisories can reduce disaster risk along Andhra Pradesh’s vulnerable coastline.
andhraPradesh.apLink: Direct AP connection: IMD warnings covered coastal Andhra Pradesh, and APSDMA issued state-specific safety advice.

sources.title: Press Release dated 22nd September 2026: A Depression lay over westcentral & adjoining northwest Bay of Bengal
Depression likely to form over Bay of Bengal on September 22, likely to move south of Odisha-North AP coast

andhraPradesh.headline: Andhra Pradesh High Court extends pension-related service regularisation relief to sericulture workers
facts: The Andhra Pradesh High Court issued a common order on four writ petitions concerning full-time contingent employees in the Sericulture Department.
The Court directed authorities to regularise the petitioners’ services with effect from 25 November 1993 for the specified pension-related purpose.
The service from that date is to count for pension and pensionary benefits; the order also provides for notional pay fixation, not a direction for back-pay of salary.
Authorities were directed to issue appropriate orders within three months of receiving the judgment.
The order relied on earlier litigation and state government orders concerning similarly placed sericulture employees.
andhraPradesh.summary: The High Court granted similarly placed sericulture employees relief consistent with earlier decisions on retrospective regularisation. The practical direction is to count service from 25 November 1993 for pension and pensionary benefits, with notional pay fixation; implementation orders are due within three months.
andhraPradesh.staticLink: Article 14 equality before law; Article 226 writ jurisdiction; public-service regularisation and pension principles.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: The order concerns notional pay fixation and pensionary counting of service; it should not be described as an award of retrospective salary.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: Discuss equal treatment of similarly situated public employees, the limits of retrospective regularisation and the fiscal-administrative consequences of pension-related service counting.
andhraPradesh.apLink: Direct AP connection: judgment of the Andhra Pradesh High Court involving the state’s Sericulture Department and employees serving in AP districts.

sources.title: G. Adambi vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, common order dated 22 September 2026

andhraPradesh.headline: YSR Kadapa district notifies 38 ASHA worker vacancies
facts: The YSR Kadapa District Medical and Health Department issued a notification for 38 ASHA worker positions under the Community Process scheme.
The announced vacancies comprise 27 rural and 11 urban positions.
Eligible women were invited to submit applications from 23 to 26 September 2026.
Applications were to be submitted through the relevant Primary Health Centres, Urban Health Centres or Village Secretariats.
The notification is a district-level recruitment announcement; it does not establish that appointments have been completed.
andhraPradesh.summary: YSR Kadapa district announced recruitment for 38 ASHA workers to support community-level health services. Applications were scheduled for 23–26 September 2026, so the development on the reporting date was the notification, not completed recruitment.
andhraPradesh.staticLink: National Health Mission; community-based primary healthcare; ASHA workers and last-mile health delivery.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: ASHA workers are community-level health facilitators; this notification is a district recruitment under the Community Process scheme.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: Examine how local health-worker recruitment can strengthen primary care access and community outreach, while identifying the importance of timely selection and training.
andhraPradesh.apLink: Direct AP connection: recruitment was announced by the YSR Kadapa District Medical and Health Department for vacancies in that district.

andhraPradesh.headline: YSR Kadapa district invites bids for one-year maintenance services at Gandikota tourism destination
facts: YSR Kadapa district invited tenders for sanitation, manpower supply and maintenance works at the Gandikota Tourism destination.
The proposed service period is one year.
The tender uses a two-cover system for technical and financial bids.
The district notice lists the tender schedule as 5–22 October 2026, with submissions closing at 5:00 PM on 22 October.
This is a procurement notice; it does not establish that a contractor has been selected or that the works have begun.
andhraPradesh.summary: The district administration issued a tender notice for routine services at the Gandikota tourism destination. Bids were scheduled to be received in October, so the development was the start of procurement rather than completed maintenance work.
andhraPradesh.staticLink: Gandikota’s historical landscape and heritage tourism; destination management and public procurement.
andhraPradesh.prelimsTakeaway: Gandikota is in YSR Kadapa district; the notice covers sanitation, manpower and maintenance services for one year.
andhraPradesh.mainsAngle: Discuss how dependable sanitation and site management support heritage tourism, local livelihoods and conservation of visitor destinations.
andhraPradesh.apLink: Direct AP connection: the tender was issued by YSR Kadapa district for the Gandikota Tourism destination in Andhra Pradesh.

national.headline: India retain Asian Games women’s cricket gold with record-breaking final win
facts: Event: women’s cricket final at the 20th Asian Games, Aichi-Nagoya 2026, in Nisshin, Japan.
India scored 216/3 and defeated Sri Lanka, which scored 69, by 147 runs.
India retained the gold it won at Hangzhou 2022; Sri Lanka took silver.
The Olympic Council of Asia reported 216/3 as the highest score by a women’s team at any Asian Games.
No AP athlete connection was established in the cited result.
national.summary: India defeated Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the women’s cricket final on 22 September. India retained its Asian Games title, and its 216/3 total set a Games record for a women’s team.
national.staticLink: Asian Games; role of sports in national identity and international representation.
national.prelimsTakeaway: India won the women’s cricket gold at Aichi-Nagoya 2026, defeating Sri Lanka in the final; India’s 216/3 was an Asian Games record for a women’s team.
national.mainsAngle: Use the result to discuss women’s participation in sport, athlete development and India’s sporting representation at multi-sport events.

sources.title: India produce record score to thrash Sri Lanka in women's cricket final

national.headline: 9th India International Water Week inaugurated in New Delhi
facts: The Vice-President inaugurated the 9th India International Water Week at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 22 September.
The Ministry of Jal Shakti is organising the event from 22 to 26 September 2026.
Theme: “Climate Resilient Water Management”.
The Netherlands and Germany are participating as partner countries; 14 States and two Central Ministries are partner participants.
The event brings together governments, international organisations, researchers, industry and civil society for policy dialogue and knowledge exchange.
national.summary: Previous: the 9th India International Water Week was announced for 22–26 September in New Delhi under the theme “Climate Resilient Water Management.” Today: the Vice-President inaugurated the event, which is now underway with partner-country, State and Central Ministry participation.
national.staticLink: Integrated water resources management; climate adaptation; Centre–State cooperation.
national.prelimsTakeaway: India International Water Week is organised by the Ministry of Jal Shakti; its 9th edition runs 22–26 September 2026 in New Delhi.
national.mainsAngle: Assess how climate-resilient water governance can combine scientific planning, community participation and intergovernmental coordination.

sources.title: Vice-President Inaugurates 9th India International Water Week 2026
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Jal Shakti

national.headline: Civil Aviation Ministry signs 21 MoUs under next phase of UDAN and launches aerodrome challenge mode
facts: The Ministry of Civil Aviation signed 21 MoUs with participating States/UTs and the Airports Authority of India under the next phase of UDAN.
The Minister launched a Challenge Mode Portal for Aerodrome Development, through which States/UTs can propose airstrips and helipads for development.
The Ministry also released a scheme document for the next round of UDAN route bidding.
The MoUs record cooperation for aviation infrastructure and regional connectivity; they do not by themselves establish completed aerodrome projects.
No AP-specific agreement or project was established by the cited release.
national.summary: On 22 September, the Ministry of Civil Aviation signed 21 MoUs for the next phase of UDAN and launched a portal to invite State/UT proposals for aerodrome development. The agreements and portal mark a new implementation step, not completed infrastructure.
national.staticLink: Regional connectivity; civil aviation infrastructure; cooperative federalism.
national.prelimsTakeaway: UDAN expands regional air connectivity; the 22 September release records 21 MoUs and a newly launched aerodrome-development challenge portal.
national.mainsAngle: Examine how Centre–State coordination and viability-gap support can improve last-mile connectivity while ensuring proposed infrastructure is financially and environmentally viable.

sources.title: Civil Aviation Minister Ram Mohan Naidu launches Challenge Mode for Aerodrome Development
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Civil Aviation

national.headline: President presents 72nd National Film Awards; Anant Nag receives Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024
facts: The President presented the 72nd National Film Awards at Ekta Nagar, Kevadia, Gujarat, on 22 September.
Veteran actor Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024.
The award recognises his contribution to Indian cinema and theatre.
The official release reported awards across feature and non-feature film categories and recognised films in multiple Indian languages.
No AP-specific awardee connection was established in the cited release.
national.summary: The 72nd National Film Awards were presented on 22 September. Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024, while the ceremony also recognised feature films, non-feature films and linguistic diversity in Indian cinema.
national.staticLink: Indian cinema as cultural expression; national cultural awards and institutions.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Anant Nag received the Dadasaheb Phalke Award for 2024 at the 72nd National Film Awards ceremony held on 22 September 2026.
national.mainsAngle: Discuss how national cultural awards can recognise artistic contribution and promote India’s linguistic and cultural diversity.

national.headline: India–Japan air exercise Veer Guardian 2026 concludes at Jodhpur
facts: Bilateral air exercise Veer Guardian 2026 between the Indian Air Force and Japan Air Self-Defense Force concluded on 22 September at Air Force Station Jodhpur.
The 14-day exercise began on 9 September.
The IAF deployed Su-30MKI, Rafale and indigenous LCA Tejas aircraft; Japan fielded the F-2A.
Training included advanced flying missions, including within-visual-range combat and coordinated multi-aircraft missions.
The exercise supported interoperability and professional exchanges between the two air forces.
national.summary: Veer Guardian 2026 concluded at Jodhpur on 22 September after 14 days of bilateral air training. The exercise involved Indian and Japanese combat aircraft and included operational, engineering and aerospace-safety exchanges.
national.staticLink: India–Japan strategic partnership; bilateral military exercises; defence interoperability.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Veer Guardian is an India–Japan bilateral air exercise; its 2026 edition concluded at Jodhpur on 22 September.
national.mainsAngle: Explain how bilateral exercises build interoperability and strategic trust, while contributing to India’s Indo-Pacific partnerships.

sources.title: IAF's joint air defence exercise with Japan ‘Exercise Veer Guardian 2026' concludes
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Defence

national.headline: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY coverage and treatment figures reported ahead of its eighth anniversary
facts: Ayushman Bharat–Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana provides up to ₹5 lakh per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
As of 21 September 2026, more than 48.51 crore Ayushman cards had been issued, according to the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare backgrounder.
As of 31 August 2026, the scheme had supported about 13.25 crore hospital admissions worth ₹2.03 lakh crore through more than 38,000 empanelled hospitals.
The scheme was launched on 23 September 2018; its eighth anniversary fell on 23 September 2026.
No AP-specific implementation figure was established in the cited release.
national.summary: A Ministry of Health and Family Welfare backgrounder published on 22 September reported PM-JAY’s coverage and treatment figures ahead of the scheme’s eighth anniversary. The reported figures include more than 48.51 crore Ayushman cards as of 21 September and 13.25 crore supported admissions as of 31 August 2026.
national.staticLink: Universal health coverage; publicly financed health insurance; social protection.
national.prelimsTakeaway: PM-JAY provides up to ₹5 lakh annual hospitalisation cover per eligible family; it was launched on 23 September 2018.
national.mainsAngle: Assess the contribution of publicly financed health assurance to financial protection, while considering access, hospital capacity and quality of care.

sources.title: Progressing Towards Universal Health Coverage: Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, National Health Authority

national.headline: National Single Window System marks five years with updated platform-performance figures
facts: The National Single Window System (NSWS) was launched on 22 September 2021 and is implemented by DPIIT under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
NSWS provides a digital interface to identify, apply for and track business-related approvals across participating Central Ministries, States and regulatory authorities.
As of 21 September 2026, the platform received an annual average of more than 3.06 lakh applications and facilitated more than 2.26 lakh approvals each year.

The Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organisation had integrated all 74 of its licensing modules with NSWS; the PIB release described it as the first department to achieve complete transaction-level integration.
No AP-specific platform-performance figure was established in the cited release.
national.summary: A PIB backgrounder published on 22 September marked five years since NSWS was launched. It reported platform-wide application and approval averages and noted PESO’s integration of all 74 licensing modules.
national.staticLink: Digital governance; single-window clearance; ease of doing business.
national.prelimsTakeaway: NSWS is implemented by DPIIT; the platform enables investors to identify, apply for and track approvals through a single interface.
national.mainsAngle: Evaluate how integrated digital approval systems can reduce compliance burdens while maintaining transparency, accountability and coordination across governments.

sources.title: National Single Window System: Transforming Business Approvals in India

international.headline: India and Visegrád Group hold inaugural V4+India foreign ministers’ meeting
facts: The inaugural V4+India foreign ministers’ meeting was held in New York on 21 September local time, corresponding to 22 September in India.
It brought together India and the Visegrád Group—Poland, Hungary, Slovakia and the Czech Republic—under Slovakia’s V4 presidency.
Ministers discussed trade and investment, technology, resilient supply chains, defence and security, connectivity, education and mobility.
The Slovak foreign ministry reported agreement to pursue regular meetings and explore business forums; the discussions also covered UN reform and energy security.
international.summary: India’s first foreign-minister-level V4+India meeting opened a multilateral channel alongside its established bilateral ties with the four Central European states. The agenda covered economic, technology, security and connectivity cooperation; the Slovak presidency said regular meetings and possible business forums would be pursued.
international.staticLink: India’s foreign policy; regional groupings and multilateral diplomacy; India-Europe economic and strategic relations.
international.prelimsTakeaway: V4 consists of Poland, Hungary, Slovakia and the Czech Republic; the inaugural V4+India ministerial meeting was held in New York during UNGA81.
international.mainsAngle: Assess how issue-based regional formats can complement India’s bilateral diplomacy and deepen links with Central Europe in trade, technology, supply chains and security.

sources.title: EAM S Jaishankar attends first V4+India Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in New York

international.headline: Greenland, Denmark and the United States sign Arctic and North Atlantic security agreement
facts: Greenland’s Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen, Denmark’s Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen and US President Donald Trump signed the agreement at UN Headquarters in New York.
The Greenland government said the agreement is intended to strengthen security in the Arctic and North Atlantic and is rooted in NATO cooperation.
The announcement says the agreement recognises the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the Kingdom of Denmark and the Greenlandic people’s right to self-determination.
It is not yet in force: the agreement must complete the necessary national parliamentary procedures.
international.summary: The three leaders signed a security agreement focused on the Arctic and North Atlantic. Its entry into force remains subject to parliamentary procedures, so the signing should not be treated as completed implementation.
international.staticLink: Arctic geopolitics; NATO and collective security; sovereignty and self-determination; strategic importance of polar regions.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The agreement was signed by Greenland, Denmark and the United States at UN Headquarters; it remains subject to national parliamentary procedures.
international.mainsAngle: Discuss how strategic competition and security partnerships in the Arctic intersect with sovereignty, self-determination and the interests of alliance partners.

international.headline: UN General Assembly’s 81st-session General Debate opens in New York
facts: The General Debate of the 81st UN General Assembly opened at UN Headquarters in New York on 22 September.
The UN schedule sets the debate for 22–26 September and 28 September 2026.
The session’s proposed theme is “Restoring Trust, Managing Transformation: A United Nations that Delivers for All.”
The General Debate is the annual forum in which member states present national positions on international issues.
international.summary: Previous: UNGA81 high-level week and its General Debate schedule had been covered. Today: the General Debate opened, beginning the scheduled leaders’ and representatives’ addresses under the session theme.
international.staticLink: United Nations system; General Assembly; multilateralism and India’s role in global governance.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The UNGA General Debate is distinct from the Assembly’s full session; the 81st-session debate opened on 22 September and is scheduled through 28 September, with a break on 27 September.
international.mainsAngle: Evaluate the General Assembly’s role as a forum for global agenda-setting and consider the challenges of restoring trust and effectiveness in multilateral institutions.

international.headline: World Rhino Day highlights conservation of the world’s five rhino species
facts: World Rhino Day is observed annually on 22 September to raise awareness about rhinoceros conservation.
The observance covers five species: black, white, greater one-horned, Sumatran and Javan rhinoceroses.
The World Rhino Day organisation says the observance was first announced by WWF-South Africa in 2010.
The International Rhino Foundation’s 2026 page reports fewer than 27,000 rhinos remain globally and says four of the five species are threatened with extinction.
international.summary: World Rhino Day draws attention to conservation of rhinos across Africa and Asia. The species list includes India’s greater one-horned rhinoceros, while the international foundation describes continued extinction risk for most species.
international.staticLink: Biodiversity conservation; threatened species; protected areas and wildlife conservation in India.
international.prelimsTakeaway: Remember the five rhino species and the annual observance date, 22 September; the greater one-horned rhino is the Asian species found in India.
international.mainsAngle: Explain the ecological and governance challenges in conserving large mammals, including habitat protection, anti-poaching efforts and transboundary cooperation.
